text.en:
Functions of the Council. The Council shall undertake the following:
Formulate policies and programs that will accord protection and provide security
to the registered vendors nationwide;
Issue within forty-five (45) days upon effectivity of this Order, the Implementing
Rules and Regulations (IRR) on the provision of security and system of
registration for all vendors nationwide which shall be formulated in consultation
with all concerned sectors and consistent with existing laws (e.g. R.A 7160 or the
Local Government Code dated 10 October 1991, RA.
Transportation Code dated 20 June 1964 );
Periodically review and revise, whenever necessary, the Implementing Rules and
Regulations of this Order;
Monitor and ensure the effective implementation of the provisions of this
Executive Order;
Submit quarterly reports to the President, as may be necessary; and,
Perform other functions as maybe directed by the President.

Coverage and System of R~istration.
The guidelines shall cover
vendors in all cities and municipalities throughout the country, whereby each city and
municipality shall establish a system for registration and issuance of permit to vendors to
protect their rights and the interest of consumers and the general public.

Designation of Workplaces. The city o!: municipality, in consultation
with vendors, the affected community and other sectors or groups, shall identify and
designate viable workplaces, and design a system of assigning spaces to registered
Workplaces include markets, vacant areas within the vicinity of markets and other
vacant public spaces which may be designated as allowable vending sites.

Empowerment
of Vendors. All concerned National GovernmentAgencie
shall provide the support necessary to the vendors' self-development into
healthy, informed, environmentally aware, progressive and productive citizens. Vendors
shall be encouraged to organize themselves into associations reflective of their ideals and
aspirations.
,/1
/, /

Policy on Eviction and Demolition. Pending the issuance of the
Implementing Rules and Regulations of this E~ecutive Order, vendors shall not be
arbitrarily deprived of their livelihood by being unjustly ejected from their workplaces nor
their stalls demolished provided that this policy shall not apply to vendors who started
occuPYing such workplaces after the effectivity of this Executive Order.

Separability Clause. If any provision of this Executive Order or the
application of such provisions is declared unconstitutional or illegal, the remaining
provisions thereof shall not be affected by such declaration.

Repealing Clause. All other orders, issuances, rules and regulations or
parts thereof inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repec.led or modified
accordingly.

Effectivity. This Executive Order takes effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this ~
day of October in the year of Our Lord,
Nineteen Hundred and Nmety-Seven.
